caption: The drawing depicts a pair of shoes viewed from above, centered within the composition. The shoes are outlined in thin, precise black lines on a light, off-white background. The left shoe (on the viewer's right) displays the top and a partial side view, with clear stitch lines indicated by dotted marks, and minimal lacing detail. The right shoe (on the viewer's left) is oriented similarly but includes a simple, visibly tied lace at the opening and slightly more inner structure visible. The background is plain and untextured, with no additional objects present. The overall style is minimalist, and the shoes are the only focus of the drawing, which is rendered in monochrome.
title: Infant's Booties
